crossRefs.note: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.

translations.web: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.
translations.bsb: The folds of his flesh are tightly joined; they are firm and immovable.
translations.kjv: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
translations.asv: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: They are firm upon him; they cannot be moved.
